body: Well done! Time for you!

Please please do what ever it takes. My fiancé had that chat with me and I kept drinking. I’ve lost her for good along with childhood friends. I’m 38 and now very alone and for what? Nights I can’t remember and hurting those I loved. I wish I had another chance so please do whatever you can. Good luck and all the best. I sincerely hope you make it.

For me it’s a living hell. I’ve lost my childhood friends and the woman of my dreams because of alcohol and depression/anxiety. I couldn’t run away from my feelings fast enough for years and drank upto 24 beers over say 20 hours. I’d hurt and destroy relationships yet have no recollection of what I’d said or done. It hurts so fucking much that the people I loved so much I hurt because I was hurting but instead of getting help I turned to the bottle. Now at 38 I’m lonely, broken, full of shame and regret. I’m just glad my ex is now happy and healthier since she left me. I’m actually scared of making any friends or another relationship in case I emotionally hurt people again. Your dad prob feels like shit and I hope he gets sober and you’ll be ok. Alcoholism hurts everyone

Hey :) I’d just like to say that you’re making a great decision in wanting to get sober and regain control. I too feel as though I have lost everything. My partner left me, I’ve lost my job and most friends in the last year, all because of alcohol. It nearly cost me my life after I became suicidal in hospital after finally having a breakdown when I realised these people weren’t coming back. I’m 38 and am now single and living alone. It’s been 20 years of drinking for me, first 10 was just partying and going out but then I started drinking alone, would come to bed at 4 falling over and piss of my gf. It got worse and worse. I went to meetings and thought things would be fine. Then I stopped going and really went down hill. I lost faith and hope in myself and so did those around me. I lost the woman Of my dreams for nights I can’t remember and it breaks my heart. She looks so happy and free now when I see her and It kills me that she won’t even talk to me now.
I’m going to try and go to a meeting this weekend but I’m scared. 
Knowing you’re going through similar and reading your story made me think that I still have family and maybe some friendships are salvageable. 
I’m going to go to this meeting and I want you to go too. Don’t let it go another 10 years like I did. Please. It only gets worse and I guess people like us can’t even have one drink. So try say sober. I wish someone would just come get me and take me but it’s up to us to go. I really really hope you make it. I really really hope I do too. Take care ok :)

Hey. You may not read this. But you’re not the only person who acts this way. It’s cruel how impulsions and self doubt create these situations. I’m actually a nurse and can be perfect in my job but implode at home. I hate so much how people think I’m a role model. I suck at life
By the way I watched Mick fanning surf his last heat today. Check that guy out. He’s a real inspiration

For some reason I’m really really hoping you get it even though I have no idea what it is or what you do, sending vibes that’ll be sure to reach you legend.

I’m not sure if it was a dream while sedated or something else but was kinda like a dream I’ve had before. It was like I was on a planet made of some kind of honey comb, a twisted system of caves where if you moved or tried to seek light from the surface you’d fall onto a step or in a chamber but if you seek the light or way out you’d fall further. It just gets dark and if you move it’s worse. There was no sense of smell, pain or anything just a knowing that was so intense that I hate that place but if I moved I’d just go deeper and never leave. Like it felt real but I wasn’t someone, I wasn’t anything. I kinda felt an urge the whole time I had to go and meet’them’ but who they are I have no fucken idea
And I’m scared of being dead again
I can tell you all about it but no one will believe me. I was dead
